title: MORNING PRAYER FOR FINANCIAL FAVOUR – MONEY IS COMING
text: I need you to do something unusual right now before I say a word of prayer, before I open a scripture, before worship begins. I need you to stretch your hands forward, both hands, palms open facing upward like someone who is about to receive something heavy. Like someone who knows that what is coming is bigger than what their hands have held before. Stretch them forward because the spirit of God told me something in my prayer room this morning that made me weep. He said, "Today is a distribution day in heaven. Today is not a teaching day. Today is not an information day. Today is a distribution day. Angels have been loaded with financial assignments. Accounts in the spirit realm have been unlocked. Transfer orders have been signed by the King of kings. And the question is not whether money is coming, the question is are your hands open to receive it? So, stretch those hands and keep them stretched. Do not bring them down until I tell you to move. Now, listen. This is not a motivational speech. This is not a prosperity sermon designed to make you feel good. What is happening in this service is a spiritual transaction. In the same way that money moves in the natural world through banks and transfers and wire systems, money moves in the spirit world through prayer and faith and prophetic decrees. And what we are about to do is initiate a spiritual wire transfer from the treasury of heaven into the accounts of your life. But first, share this. Share it now. Send it to every group. Post it on every platform, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, everywhere. Because there is somebody right now, maybe in your office, maybe in your neighborhood, maybe in another country entirely, who has been crying to God about money. They have been fasting about provision. They have been losing sleep over bills. They have been borrowing to survive. And this prayer, this very prayer, is the answer that God has prepared for them. If you withhold this link, you are withholding their answer. If you keep this to yourself, you are keeping someone in bondage. Do not do that. Be the angel that delivers their miracle. Share it now. Good. Your hands are still stretched. Keep them there. We're about to enter worship. But this worship is different. This is not entertainment. This is not performance. This is the creation of an atmosphere, a spiritual ecosystem in which financial miracles thrive, because miracles do not happen in just any atmosphere. They happen in the atmosphere of worship. They happen in the atmosphere of faith. They happen in the atmosphere of surrender. Sing with me. Let your voice join mine, and do not hold back. Sing like your rent depends on it. Sing like your debt cancellation is hidden in the melody. Sing like your business breakthrough is encoded in the harmony. All I want is you, Jesus. All I want is you. All I want is you, Jesus. All I want is you. You are my source. You are my sustainer. You are my provider. You are my portion. All I want is you. All I want is you, Jesus. All I want is you. Nothing else will satisfy. All I want is you. Let it go deeper. Let the song become a prayer. Let the melody become a cry. Let the harmony become a declaration. You are not just singing, you are building an altar. And on that altar, God is going to lay your financial breakthrough like a sacrifice in rivers. Not something you give up, but something he lays down for you. Father, we worship you not because of what you give, but because of who you are. You are Jehovah Jireh, the Lord who provides. You saw Abraham on the mountain with his son, and you provided a ram in the thicket, Genesis chapter 22 verse 14. You did not wait for Abraham to ask, you did not wait for Abraham to beg. You saw and you provided. That is who you are. You are the God who sees the need before the mouth opens. You are the God who prepares the answer before the question is asked. You are the God who hides provision in places we have not yet looked, and we worship you, Jehovah Jireh, our provider. You are more than enough, more than enough for me. Jehovah Jireh, our provider. You are more than enough, more than enough for me. You are not a man that you should lie. You are not the son of man that you should repent. Has he said, and shall he not do it? Has he spoken, and shall he not make it good? Numbers chapter 23 verse 19. If God has spoken provision over your life, and he has then provision must come. It must. It has no choice. The word of God does not return void. Isaiah chapter 55 verse 11. It accomplishes. It prospers. It produces. And the word of God over your finances is producing results right now. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Bring your hands down now. Slowly. Let the anointing that has settled on your palms soak into your skin. That anointing is the anointing for receiving. That anointing is the anointing for financial magnetism. Whatever your hands touch from today is going to prosper. Whatever your hands build from today is going to multiply. Whatever your hands reach for from today is going to be granted. Your hands have been anointed for wealth. Now sit down in the spirit, take your seat, but let your spirit remain at full attention because what I am about to teach you is going to become the foundation for the most powerful financial prayer you have ever prayed. Open your Bible or your Bible app and go with me to Deuteronomy chapter 8 verse 18. The Bible says, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day." Underline three words in that verse: power, wealth, covenant. Power. God gives you power to get wealth. Not advice, not a suggestion, not a nudge, power. The Hebrew word here is koach. It means force, ability, strength, capacity. God deposits into you a supernatural force that generates wealth. It is not just about working hard, it is not just about being smart, it is not just about having the right connections. There is a spiritual force, a divine energy that God places inside certain people that causes money to flow toward them. That force is what the Bible calls the power to get wealth. And notice, he gives you the power to get wealth, not the power to beg for wealth, not the power to wish for wealth, not the power to dream about wealth, the power to get it, to acquire it, to accumulate it, to generate it. God is not dropping cash from the sky, though he could if he wanted to. He's equipping you with an internal mechanism that makes you a wealth generator, a money magnet, a prosperity machine. And why does he do it? The verse tells us to establish his covenant. God gives you wealth for a reason. Not so you can live in luxury while others suffer. Not so you can show off on social media. Not so you can compete with your neighbors. He gives you wealth to establish his covenant, to fund his purposes, to finance his kingdom, to be a channel of provision for his agenda in the earth. When you understand this, everything changes. Money is no longer something you chase. It is something that chases you because you are aligned with God's purpose, because you are a covenant partner. Because you are a kingdom financier. And God does not let his financiers go broke. He does not let his covenant partners remain in lack. He does not let his kingdom investors suffer loss. Now, go with me to a second scripture. Psalm 35:27. Let them shout for joy and be glad that favor my righteous cause. Yea, let them say continually, let the Lord be magnified. Which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. Did you catch that? God has pleasure in your prosperity. He enjoys seeing you prosper. He takes delight in your financial success. He does not frown when you have money. He does not get angry when you are wealthy. He does not consider you unspiritual because you are rich. He has pleasure in it. It makes him happy. It brings him joy. Some people have been taught that poverty is holiness. That lack is spirituality. That suffering is godliness. That is a lie from the pit of hell dressed in religious clothing. God is not glorified by your poverty. God is glorified by your prosperity when that prosperity is used for his purposes. When the bills are paid and there is still money left for kingdom work. When the family is provided for and there is still seed for the harvest. When the needs are met and there is still generosity flowing from your life to the lives of others. Third John chapter 1 verse 2. Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth. God wishes above all things. Meaning this is his highest wish for you that you prosper. If God's highest wish for you is prosperity, then poverty must be an enemy. If God's chief desire is your financial well-being, then lack must be an opposition. And what opposes God's desire must be confronted, must be challenged, must be defeated. And that is exactly what we're about to do. We're about to confront the spirit of poverty. We're about to challenge the principality of lack. We are about to defeat every demonic system that has been siphoning your finances, blocking your provision, diverting your resources, and keeping you in a cycle of insufficiency. But before we pray, let me give you one more key. Because keys are what open doors and the door to financial breakthrough requires a specific key. Go with me to Malachi chapter 3 verses 10 to 12. This is one of the most quoted but least understood scriptures on finances. God says, "Bring you all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now here with, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground. Neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, sayeth the Lord of hosts. And all nations shall call you blessed, for ye shall be a delightsome land, sayeth the Lord of hosts. Three things happen when you honor God with your finances, three supernatural activations. First, God opens the windows of heaven, not a window, windows, plural. Multiple channels of provision swing open simultaneously. Money does not just come from one source, it comes from everywhere. From the north and the south and the east and the west, from expected and unexpected sources, from people you know and people you have never met, windows, plural, everywhere. Second, God rebukes the devourer. The devourer is the spiritual entity responsible for financial wastage. Have you ever wondered why your money disappears so fast? Why you earn a good income but never seem to have enough? Why unexpected expenses always show up right after payday? That is the devourer at work. He eats your finances before you can use them. But when you honor God, God himself, not an angel, not a prophet, God himself rebukes the devourer. He puts a divine restraining order on every entity that has been consuming your wealth. Third, nations will call you blessed. Your prosperity becomes so visible, so undeniable, so outstanding that it becomes a testimony to the nations. People look at you and say God has blessed this person. That is the level of wealth we are praying into today, not survival, not just enough, national level blessing, international level prosperity, the kind that makes people ask what is your secret? And the answer is my God. Now I need to add one more layer before we pray. And this is a revelation that the Holy Spirit dropped in my heart specifically for this service. Go with me to 2 Kings chapter 7 verses 1 to 2. Elisha prophesied, "Hear you the word of the Lord, thus saith the Lord. Tomorrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel and two measures of barley for a shekel in the gate of Samaria." Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God and said, "Behold, if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be?" And he said, "Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shall not eat thereof." Samaria was under siege. There was a severe famine. People were starving. The economy had completely collapsed. Prices were so inflated that they were selling dove dung for food. It was catastrophic. But in the middle of this catastrophe, Elisha made a prophetic declaration. Tomorrow, by this time tomorrow, things would change, prices would normalize, provision will flood the market, the famine will break, the siege will end. And the lord who leaned on the king's hand, the advisor, the expert, the one who relied on human analysis, he laughed. He said, "Even if God opened windows in heaven, this could not happen." His problem was not lack of information. His problem was lack of faith. And because of his unbelief, Elisha told him, "You will see the miracle, but you will not participate in it." I am making the same prophetic declaration over your life this morning. Money is coming today, not tomorrow, not next week, not next month, today. By the time this day is over, something will shift in your financial reality. A notification will come, a conversation will happen, an idea will drop, a connection will be made, a door will crack open. Money is on the way. Provision is in transit. Wealth is being transferred. but I must also issue the same warning. If you hear this word and you scoff, if you dismiss it as hype, if you say in your heart, "Even if God opened windows in heaven, my bills are too many, my debts are too deep, my situation is too far gone," then you will see others testify, but you will not have your own testimony. Unbelief disqualifies, doubt cancels, skepticism aborts. So, right now, I need you to make a decision. Are you going to believe? Are you going to receive? Are you going to stretch your faith to the breaking point and say, "I believe that money is coming today. I believe that my financial story is about to change. I believe that the God of Elisha is my God, and what he did for Samaria, he will do for me." If that is your decision, if you have decided to believe, then open your mouth and shout, "Money is coming today." Say it again, "Money is coming today." One more time with everything inside you, "Money is coming today." Hallelujah. Now, let us pray. Stand to your feet. This is not a sitting prayer. This is a standing prayer. This is a marching prayer. This is a warfare prayer. When Joshua was about to take Jericho, God did not tell him to sit in a tent and meditate. God told him to march, to move, to walk, to circle, to shout. The posture of warfare is the posture of action. So, stand and get ready to pray the prayer of your financial life. Father, almighty God, Jehovah Jireh, El Shaddai, the God who is more than enough, the God who owns the cattle on a thousand hills, the God who said, "The silver is mine and the gold is mine." We come before your throne right now, not as beggars, but as sons and daughters. Not as slaves, but as heirs. Not as orphans, but as children of the king. Romans chapter 8:17, "And if children, then heirs, heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ." We are heirs. We have an inheritance. We have a portion. We have a share in the wealth of heaven, and we are here to claim it. We are here to access it. We are here to withdraw from the account of heaven and deposit into the accounts of earth. Now, open your mouth and pray. Do not whisper. Do not mumble. Do not think your prayer. Pray it. Shout it. Declare it. Because the Bible says in Job chapter 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Decree. When you decree, things get established. When you declare, things become reality. When you speak, creation listens. Your words are not empty sounds. Your words are containers of power. Your words are vehicles of destiny. So, fill your mouth with decrees and watch heaven respond. Decree this with me. I decree that financial favor rest upon my life from this day forward. I am not cursed. I am blessed. I am not poor. I am prosperous. I am not lacking. I am abundant. I am not borrowing. I am lending. I am not begging. I am giving. The blessing of Abraham is upon my life. Galatians chapter 3:14, "What God promised to Abraham, blessing, multiplication, expansion, dominion, it is mine through faith in Christ Jesus." I decree that every financial door that has been shut against me is opening right now. I do not care who shut it. I do not care how long it has been shut. I do not care how many padlocks are on it. The God I serve holds the of David. Revelation chapter 3 verse 7. He that openeth and no man shuteth and shuteth and no man openeth. He is opening my doors. And no man, no boss, no government, no committee, no enemy, no devil can shut what God has opened. I decree that money is coming to me today, not next year, not next quarter, today from sources I know and sources I do not know. Through channels I can see and channels I cannot see. By methods I understand and methods that defy understanding, money is coming. It is being released. It is in transit. It is approaching. It is landing. It is here. Oh, the fire is falling. I can feel it. The anointing for financial breakthrough is being released right now. Something is happening in the heavenlies. Something is shifting. Thrones of poverty are being toppled. Chains of lack are being shattered. Gates of provision are swinging wide open. I can sense the movement of angels. I can hear the sound of abundance approaching. Now, I want to pray specifically for the destruction of the spirit of poverty because poverty is not just a condition, it is a spirit. It is an entity. It has personality. It has strategy. It has assignment and its assignment is to keep you broke, to keep you begging, to keep you insufficient, to keep you dependent on everyone except God. The spirit of poverty operates through several mechanisms. First, it creates financial leakages. You earn money but it disappears. You get paid but by the end of the week you cannot account for where it went. Haggai chapter 1 verse 6, "Ye have sown much and bring in little. Ye eat but you have not enough. Ye drink but you are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you but there is none warm." "And he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes, a bag with holes." That is the work of the spirit of poverty. It puts holes in your bag. It creates leakages in your finances. It ensures that no matter how much comes in, it all goes out. Second, the spirit of poverty creates cycles of debt. You borrow to pay one debt and create another. You take a loan to solve a problem and create a bigger problem. You never break free. You are always owing somebody, always carrying the weight of another person's money on your shoulders. Third, the spirit of poverty creates an atmosphere of scarcity around your life. Even when there is abundance available, you never seem to access it. Jobs pass you by. Contracts go to others. Promotions keep you. Opportunities evaporate. There is always something blocking the flow of money into your life. But today that spirit is being confronted. Today that entity is being evicted. Today that assignment is being terminated. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I bind the spirit of poverty. I bind you in every dimension you operate. I bind you in my finances. I bind you in my career. I bind you in my business. I bind you in my investments. I bind you in my family's finances. You are bound. You are restricted. You are paralyzed. You can no longer operate. You can no no steal. You can no longer leak, you can no longer divert, you can no longer block. Your power is broken, your authority is stripped, your assignment is cancelled. I command the spirit of poverty to leave my life right now. Get out of my accounts, get out of my business, get out of my career, get out of my ideas, get out of my confidence, get out of MY BLOODLINE. GET OUT IN THE NAME of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is against you. The fire of the Holy Ghost consuming you. The sword of the spirit is cutting you down. You must go. And I sew up every hole in my financial bag, every leakage sealed by the blood, every crack filled by the fire, every gap closed by the word. From today, what comes in stays. What God gives me, the enemy cannot take. What heaven deposits, hell cannot withdraw. My bag has no holes, my basket has no cracks. My account has no unauthorized access. In Jesus' name. Now, let me pray for your destiny because financial breakthrough is connected to destiny. When your destiny is activated, money flows toward it. Money follows purpose, resources chase vision. Capital pursues assignment. If your destiny is dormant, money has no reason to come. Father, I speak to the destiny of every person in this service. I command every dormant destiny to awaken. I command every delayed purpose to accelerate. I command every frustrated assignment to be unblocked. Every calling that has been in a coma, come alive now. Every vision that has been in a cage, break free now. Every dream that has been buried alive, rise from the grave now. Jeremiah chapter 1 verse 5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. And before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. You were known before you were born. You were sanctified before you were delivered. You were ordained before you took your first breath. Your life is not an accident. Your existence is not a mistake. You are a purpose carrier, a destiny bearer, an assignment holder, and the resources to fund that purpose are already allocated in heaven. They just need your destiny to wake up so they know where to land. I decree, your destiny is awake, your purpose is active, your assignment is engaged, and the finances that are attached to your calling are being released. Now, kingdom money released. Covenant wealth released. Purpose provision released. Destiny capital released. Every fund that has been waiting for your activation is hitting your account today. Now, family deliverance. Because generational financial patterns are real. If your father was poor, and his father was poor, and his father was poor, that is not coincidence. That is a pattern. A spiritual template that has been running in your family for generations, and it will continue to run unless someone breaks it. You are that someone. You are the circuit breaker. You are the pattern disruptor. You are the one God has chosen to end the cycle and start a new lineage. In the name of Jesus, I break every generational pattern of poverty in my family line. Every ancestor who made a covenant with poverty, I break that covenant now. Every grandmother who was dedicated to a spirit of lack, I cancel that dedication now. Every grandfather who traded his family's financial future at an altar of darkness, I reverse that transaction now. The old pattern is dead. A new financial DNA is being written over my family, wealth, prosperity, abundance, overflow. That is the new pattern. That is the new normal. That is the new inheritance. I speak to my children born and unborn, you will never know poverty. You will never experience lack. You will never beg for bread. The God of your father and your mother is Jehovah Jireh. And he provides. He always provides. Psalm 37:25. I have been young and now I'm old, yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread. My seed will not beg for bread. My children will not stand in line for charity. My descendants will not know the sting of insufficiency. They will be lenders. They will be employers. They will be philanthropists. They will be kingdom financiers. The generational pattern of poverty ends with me. Now, marriage, because financial stress is one of the biggest killers of marriages. And some of you have been experiencing tension in your homes because money is tight. Conversations become arguments. Silence replaces intimacy. Blame replaces support. And the enemy uses financial pressure to wedge between husband and wife. Father, I pray for every marriage in this service. Let financial breakthrough bring peace to their homes. Let provision restore joy to their bedrooms. Let abundance heal the wounds that poverty inflicted. Let the money that comes into their hands today become medicine for their marriage. For those who are single and believing for marriage, I decree that financial breakthrough removes every barrier. Some of you have not been able to marry because you could not afford it. Some of you have not been able to propose because you had no ring, no house, no stability. Some of you have been rejected because your financial status was deemed insufficient. But I decree the financial breakthrough that is coming today is going to change your marital status. When the money comes the wedding follows. When provision arrives the family begins. You will not be unmarried for financial reasons any longer. God is providing for your home before you build it. He's funding your family before you start it. I feel the atmosphere changing. I sense money moving in the spirit realm. I can almost hear the sound of financial gates creaking open old rusty gates that have been shut for years now swinging on their hinges because the hand of God is pushing them open. I am going to prophesy right now and I need you to receive it. There is someone in this service who has been owed money for a very long time a substantial sum and you have given up on ever receiving it. The spirit of God is saying do not give up. Within the next 14 days the person who owes you will reach out not because they suddenly developed a conscience because God will touch their heart. Proverbs chapter 21 verse 1. God is turning their heart like a river of water. The money is coming back with an apology and possibly with interest receive it. There is someone who has been praying for a specific job a particular company a particular position a particular salary. You applied months ago and had nothing. You assumed it was dead. The spirit of God is showing me that the application was never dead. It was in a holding pattern like an airplane circling the airport waiting for clearance to land and the clearance is being given now. Within the next 10 days, expect a call, expect an email, expect an invitation. The job is not lost. It was waiting for this prayer. Receive it. Hallelujah. Now, I want to pray for health and healing. You may wonder what does healing have to do with financial favor? Everything. Because the biggest financial drain in many people's lives is medical bills. The enemy knows this. He sends sickness not just to kill your body, but to bankrupt your family. He sends disease not just to cause pain, but to drain your savings. Hospital bills, medication costs, specialist consultations, surgical fees. The enemy uses sickness as a financial weapon. But when God heals you, he does not just restore your body, he protects your finances. Every healing is a financial miracle in disguise. Every cure is a savings account in action. Every restoration is a bill that never needs to be paid. Exodus chapter 23:25, "And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread and thy water, and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee." God takes sickness away. He does not manage it, he does not reduce it, he takes it away, removes it, eliminates it, eradicates it. So, I pray now, Father, heal every person in this service whose finances have been drained by sickness, heal the disease, cancel the medical bills, restore the funds that were spent on treatments that did not work. Let the healing power of Christ do what medicine could not. I speak to every body part that is malfunctioning. I speak to every organ that is diseased. I speak to every system that is failing. In the name of Jesus Christ, function properly, operate correctly, work as God designed you to work. Cancer, your assignment is cancelled. You are dying right now. Not the patient, the cancer is dying. Diabetes, your grip is broken. Blood sugar normalize now. Insulin flow correctly now. Heart conditions be repaired now. Kidney problems be resolved now. Liver conditions be healed now. Lung diseases be reversed now. Blood disorders be corrected now. Auto immune conditions, your body is no longer attacking itself. The immune system is being recalibrated right now. I speak to chronic pain, leave now. I speak to persistent headache, stop now. I speak to hormonal imbalances be corrected now. I speak to reproductive issues be healed now. I speak to every condition that has a name, I rename it. It is no longer a diagnosis, it is a former diagnosis. It is history, it is past tense. You were sick, but you are healed by his stripes. Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5. And as the healing manifests, the money that would have gone to hospitals stays in your pocket. The money that would have been spent on medication becomes seed for your business. The money that would have been drained by medical emergencies becomes capital for your children's education. Every healing is a financial rescue. Receive your healing. Receive your financial rescue. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, the sweet fellowship of the Holy Spirit be upon your finances, be upon your career, be upon your business, be upon your investments. Be upon your savings, be upon your spending, be upon your giving, be upon every financial dimension of your existence from this morning through this day, through this week, through this month, through this year, and for the rest of your wealthy, prosperous, abundant, overflowing, kingdom-funded life. You came into this service with empty hands, you are leaving with loaded hands. You came with a deficit, you are leaving with a surplus. You came with questions about money, you are leaving with heaven's answer. You came poor in spirit, you are leaving rich in faith, and where faith goes, money follows. Amen. And amen. And forever. Amen.
